constants.why: cart-pole plant: distance of the pole mass from the pivot

constants.why: cart-pole plant: the cart must stay within this distance of the track centre

constants.why: pendulum plant: viscous damping coefficient b

constants.why: cart-pole plant: viscous damping coefficient of the pole

constants.why: initial cart position is drawn uniformly within plus or minus this value

constants.why: success criterion: absolute pole angle below this value (rad)

constants.name: upright_rate_tol
constants.why: success criterion: absolute angular rate (and cart velocity) below this value

constants.name: q_rate_weight
constants.why: default quadratic state weight Q on the rate entries (pendulum and cart-pole)
